title: Predictions UI: show only eligible colleges returned by backend

requirements.summary: Update the predictions results UI copy and table rendering to assume the backend returns only eligible colleges (predicted_rank <= closing_rank) and present the filtered list correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: After running predictions, the table only displays colleges that meet predicted_rank <= closing_rank (as returned by the backend).
Any user-facing text describing results is in English and does not imply that non-eligible records are shown.

file_operations.description: Adjust the Results Section to reflect that returned predictions are already eligibility-filtered by the backend (predicted_rank <= closing_rank): update any headings/descriptions and empty-state messages to explicitly say the list contains eligible options only; ensure the table renders correctly when only eligible rows are present (including consistent rendering of predicted_rank/closing_rank and any existing eligibility indicator fields). If the UI currently implies it shows all evaluated colleges, revise the English copy accordingly. Use existing shadcn-ui components already present in this file (e.g., Table, Alert, Badge, Card) to present the updated messaging and results styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
